Name: Position
Description: Group containing parameters for adjusting the position of the terrain or object within the workspace.

Name: Offset X
Description: Shifts the terrain or object horizontally along the X axis, allowing precise placement within the scene.

Name: Offset Y
Description: Shifts the terrain or object horizontally along the Y axis, moving it forward or backward in the workspace.

Name: Offset Z
Description: Moves the terrain or object vertically along the Z axis, raising or lowering its elevation.

Name: Scale
Description: Group containing parameters for scaling the terrain or object, affecting its size and proportions.

Name: Uniform
Description: Applies uniform scaling to all axes, maintaining the original proportions of the terrain or object.

Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall scale factor, resizing the terrain or object uniformly in all directions.

Name: Scale X
Description: The non-uniform scale on the X axis, allowing independent horizontal stretching or compression.

Name: Scale Y
Description: The non-uniform scale on the Y axis, allowing independent vertical stretching or compression.

Name: Rotation
Description: Group containing parameters for rotating the terrain or object around its axes.

Name: Angle
Description: The angle of rotation applied to the terrain or object, measured in degrees.

Name: Settings
Description: Group containing additional settings for the transform operation, such as blending and edge handling.

Name: Blend Mode
Description: Specifies how the transformed terrain or object is merged with the underlying data or input.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No blending is applied; the transformed data overwrites the input.

Flubs.Name: Blend
Flubs.Description: Blends the transformed data with the input using standard alpha or linear blending.

Flubs.Name: Add
Flubs.Description: Adds the transformed values to the input, increasing elevation or intensity.

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description: Subtracts the transformed values from the input, creating depressions or reductions.

Flubs.Name: Difference
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes the difference between the transformed data and the input.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: Multiplies the transformed data with the input, modulating the result.

Flubs.Name: Screen
Flubs.Description: Uses a screen blend, lightening the result where both inputs are present.

Flubs.Name: Max
Flubs.Description: Takes the maximum value between the transformed data and the input at each point.

Flubs.Name: Min
Flubs.Description: Takes the minimum value between the transformed data and the input at each point.

Name: Edges
Description: Specifies how the edges of the transformed terrain or object are handled.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No special edge handling; edges may be abrupt or unblended.

Flubs.Name: Thin
Flubs.Description: Applies a thin edge blend, softening the transition at the boundaries.

Flubs.Name: Wide
Flubs.Description: Applies a wide edge blend, creating a broader transition zone at the boundaries.

Flubs.Name: Soft
Flubs.Description: Applies a soft, gradual edge blend for smooth transitions.

Name: Quality
Description: Sets the processing quality for the transform operation.

Flubs.Name: Draft
Flubs.Description: Fastest processing with lower quality, suitable for previews.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced quality and performance for general use.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: Highest quality with the most detail, recommended for final output.
